# pve_notification_endpoint_sendmail (Resource)

Manages a sendmail notification endpoint (`POST/PUT/DELETE /cluster/notifications/endpoints/sendmail/{name}`). Every mutation is synchronous per the pin (no task is spawned).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_notification_endpoint_sendmail" "ops_mail" {
  name         = "ops-mail"
  mailto       = ["ops@example.com"]
  mailto_user  = ["root@pam"]
  from_address = "pve@example.com"
  author       = "PVE cluster"
  comment      = "Mail notifications for the ops team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint (PVE `pve-configid` format). Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `author` (String) Author of the mail. Removed when unset on update.
- `comment` (String) Comment. Removed when unset on update.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target. PVE defaults to `false`.
- `from_address` (String) `From` address for the mail. Removed when unset on update.
- `mailto` (List of String) List of email recipients (PVE `email-or-username` format). Removed when unset on update.
- `mailto_user` (List of String) List of PVE users (e.g. `root@pam`) whose configured mail addresses receive the notification. Removed when unset on update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing sendmail endpoint by its name:
terraform import pve_notification_endpoint_sendmail.ops_mail ops-mail
```
